delivery.title: Ka jingpynpoi ba bniah - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: Ka "Pass" hangne ​​ka mut tang ba u server ba la thmu u la pynphai ia ka jinglong HTTP 2xx - kam pynthikna ba ka system ba pdiang ka la buh ne pyntreikam shisha ia ka lead. Peit ia ka met jubab haneng na ka bynta kaei kaba ka la ong ha ka jingshisha; lada ka long kaba thylli ne tang ka jingpynpaw, kata ka system ka lah ban pdiang ia ka jingkyrpad hynrei ka kyntait ne iehnoh ia ka jingkit hapoh (ki kyrteng/jingpynbeit ba bakla na ka bynta API jong ka , ka jaka ba donkam ha ka liang jong ka ba kane ka jingkit kam kynthup, bad kiwei kiwei).

api.title: API jong phi - Ka jingrung ar lynti na ka bynta kano kano ka system
api.intro: Kano kano ka system kaba don ia u shabi API jong phi ka lah ban shna, pule bad pynthymmai ia ki nongialam bad ban shim bynta ia ki jingjia jong ki nongialam. Phah ia u shabi ha ka khlieh <hdr></hdr> , kum <bearer></bearer> , lane (lada ka tiar kam lah ban buh ia ki khlieh) kum <query></query> . Ka jingthew: {{limit}} ki jingkyrpad ha ka minit.
